constraints.description: Every evidence class states what it proves and does not prove.
Synthetic or recorded responses cannot certify genuine model inference.
Fail-closed claims require observed failure, bounded inversion, exact restoration, and positive rerun.
Tier timing, delivery-first cadence, profile limits, and deployment-only Actions remain explicit.

validation.validation_method: testing-history, publication, and Actions policy validation

constraints.description: No product test, model call, soak, build, browser, deployment, or readiness claim is made.

global_rules: Evidence must cross the boundary named in the claim.
Results transfer to no unnamed source SHA or profile.
termination_conditions: All blocking constraints pass observed local controls.
No runtime, test, application, dependency, lockfile, workflow, vendor, submodule, or raw-history edit remains.
